ticker_news.title: Should You Buy the Dip in Micron Stock Right Now?
ticker_news.description: Micron Technology's latest earnings report failed to meet Wall Street's expectations, leading to an 18% drop in the stock price. However, the author argues that Micron's long-term potential remains strong, with its position in the growing AI chip market and attractive valuation compared to peers.
ticker_news.author: Adam Spatacco

ticker_news.title: 3 Tech Giants Gaining Analyst Support With Upgraded Price Targets
ticker_news.description: Three major tech companies - Meta Platforms, Amazon, and Alphabet - have recently received price target upgrades from analysts, indicating growing confidence in their potential to deliver strong returns in the coming year.
ticker_news.author: Marketbeat.Com

ticker_news.title: Northwestern University Student Shares Educational and Career Updates After Receiving SBB Research Group Foundation STEM Scholarship
ticker_news.description: Vivian Chen, a computer science student at Northwestern University, received a $2,500 STEM scholarship from the SBB Research Group Foundation in 2024. Since then, she has completed two internships at Amazon and plans to pursue a career as a software engineer or in technology.
